title: HQP: A Human-Annotated Dataset for Detecting Online Propaganda
findings: Models fine-tuned on the HQP+ dataset demonstrated robust and high performance in detecting anti-Muslim propaganda. The performance across different propaganda contexts, including the religious one, was largely consistent, with AUC scores reaching up to 78.05 for BERTweet in the anti-Muslim context.
